verdict.rationale: The RTX 5070 Ti is a graphics card, and user-defined event-triggered automation rules are not a capability buyers expect from GPU hardware, so this axis is a category error. Nothing in the evidence shows the product shipping such a rules engine. G-Assist is described only as an assistant to 'tune, control, and optimize' the system, not as event-driven rule automation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
